objective: Add the first pure Rust Cloud IaC OpenTofu module-registry API boundary so domain registry records can produce discovery, versions, and download DTOs with request, authorization identifier/surface, and path/version validation while preserving no REST server, live endpoint, auth runtime, database adapter, signing, SLSA/VSA, tofu plan/apply, provider runtime, FD-001 dogfood tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: The API boundary produces a discovery DTO with modules.v1 and the well-known path shape but does not claim a live HTTPS endpoint.
The API boundary models versions and download response DTOs using namespace/name/system/version addressing.
Download DTOs return the exact pinned module source already validated by the domain registry; no remote source resolution occurs.
SLSA/VSA remains an explicit non-claim; this API boundary generates no attestation.

implemented_claims: Added oya-cloud-iac-api as a workspace member and registry/catalog API package for Cloud IaC module-registry protocol DTO construction.
Extended the pure domain ModuleRegistry with semver-ordered versions lookup and validation for namespace/name/system/version path segments before lookup.
Added API-boundary functions for discovery, versions, and download DTOs with request-id, authorization principal/decision identifier, and authorization-surface checks before reading registry data.
Updated Cloud IaC manifest with module_registry_api_boundary_scope, capability, IP record, and explicit non-claims.

Tests prove discovery shape, versions shape/order, pinned download location, unauthorized rejection, invalid path rejection, missing version rejection, empty request rejection, and no secret-like debug output.
Tests prove non-empty authorization principal and decision identifiers are required before discovery, versions, or download DTO construction.
explicit_non_claims: no REST server or HTTP router
no registry publish path or object-store serving
no authentication or Cedar runtime integration
no module signing, Sigstore, or cosign execution
no SLSA or VSA attestation generation or verification
no provider API calls, credentials, runtime, or cloud resource provisioning
no FD-001 microservice dogfood tenant workload hosting or production tenant workload evidence
false_green_findings_closed: The protocol-fixture JSON shape now has a Rust API-boundary counterpart for DTO construction instead of remaining fixture-only.
Module versions lookup now validates namespace/name/system and returns semver-ordered versions instead of relying on untyped release-index path strings.
Download DTO construction now resolves an exact domain registry version and returns the pinned source location without claiming live download serving.
Authorization-surface checks are code-backed metadata checks only and cannot be mistaken for a live auth runtime because the manifest and evidence preserve the runtime non-claim.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed by this ChangeSet; repo-wide unrelated blockers remain outside this Cloud IaC slice.

Cloud IaC still needs future slices for an actual REST/HTTP registry server, live service discovery and module versions/download endpoints, registry publish path, object-store serving, authentication/Cedar runtime integration, database adapter, module signing/Sigstore/cosign, SLSA attestations, independent provider provenance/VSA verification, tofu tests, plan/apply evidence, provider-resource-complete modules, and live GitOps/provider integration evidence.
The new API crate is a pure in-process boundary; it does not expose network routes or persist registry data.
Concurrent unrelated application-shell and other agent work exists in the worktree; this ChangeSet does not claim or modify those surfaces.
The complementary /Users/jasonlee/Developer/source/plan files informed sequencing only and are not treated as source-of-truth implementation evidence.

FD-001 remains the master-plan product delivery goal and Oyatie Cloud must later prove itself by hosting FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads; this API-boundary ChangeSet provides no tenant-workload dogfood evidence.
